name: Variable-speed drive run-enable interface
summary: Carries a permitted run command to the drive control interface.
description: Carries a permitted run command to the drive control interface. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Run permission” at the input and “Drive enable signal” at the output. Run enable differs from a safety-rated torque-off function.
